basic_profile.bio: A passionate homebrewer based in Portland, Oregon, who's been experimenting with different beer styles for the past three years. I work as a software engineer by day and transform my garage into a mini-brewery by night. I am single and enjoy going on hiking trips over the weekend. My online hours are typically late evenings after work and weekends when I'm not out exploring a new trail.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and a minor in chemistry, which sparked my interest in the science of brewing. I've been self-teaching through online courses and forums, and I've attended several local brewing workshops. My tech background also keeps me engaged with the latest developments in Android VR technology.
